THE FOURBALL, EP 3 "BIG DAVE'S RECEIPTS": 2 PHOTOS
=================================================
Use the same ChatGPT conversation as Big Dave and Phil so they match.
Everything else in the episode reuses photos we already have, and the phone
screen is our real live scorecard, added in the edit.

STYLE (both): bright, natural, realistic photo, UK parkland golf course in
autumn, soft late-afternoon light, portrait 1024x1536, face and action in the
middle with clear space at the top and bottom, NO words, letters, numbers,
logos or brand names anywhere (the phone screen must be plain and dark).
